The vehicle (VEH) was 0.5% hydroxyethyl cellulose (Sigma-Aldrich, #09368) in ddH2O. Each compound was prepared on each day of use and administered to mice using an oral gavage in a volume of 5 mL/kg body weight.

handling.evidence: The first phase of each experiment involved handling each mouse for 5 min per day on three consecutive days to adjust them to human contact.

(HTR mice were caged singly from 2 days before testing; CSS mice lived with a CD-1 mouse behind a perforated divider; CON mice were kept as pairs of littermates.)

assays.assay_description: Counterbalanced crossover (VEH vs PSY or VEH vs ETH, 3 mg/kg p.o., 3-4 day washout); singly caged mice observed in their cage base with a transparent PVC sheet replacing the grid/lid; HTRs scored continuously by a blinded experimenter for 60 min post-administration, analysed in 4 × 15-min blocks.

application_type.evidence: were administered per os either PSY at 3 mg/kg and VEH or ETH at 3 mg/kg and VEH

setup_habituation.evidence: At 2 days prior to the onset of testing, mice (n = 6 per compound or VEH) were caged singly and were adjusted to the cage set up used for testing: rather than the usual cage grid and lid, a sheet of transparent PVC was placed on top of the cage base for 60 min

setup_restrain.evidence: Directly after administration, the transparent PVC lid was placed on the cage base situated directly beneath a video camera.

food_restriction.evidence: Food access during the HTR session is not stated; the usual cage grid and lid were replaced by a transparent PVC sheet. General statement 'food and water were available continuously' refers to housing.

water_restriction.evidence: Water access during the HTR session is not stated; the usual cage grid and lid were replaced by a transparent PVC sheet.

time_to_assay.evidence: Directly after administration, the transparent PVC lid was placed on the cage base... For 60 min postadministration, an experimenter blinded to compound/VEH scored head twitch responses (HTRs) continuously

sample_size.evidence: Mice (n = 6 per experiment), using a cross-over, counter-balanced design with a 3-4-day washout period, were administered per os either PSY at 3 mg/kg and VEH or ETH at 3 mg/kg and VEH

outcomes.summary: A single 3 mg/kg oral dose of psilocybin or ethocybin increased HTR frequency over 60 min relative to vehicle in male mice; ethocybin produced more HTRs than psilocybin. HTR frequency showed a small monotonic decrease across 15-min blocks for both psychedelics (descriptive).
outcomes.statistics: PSY vs VEH paired t-test: t = 6.77, df = 5, p = 0.001; ETH vs VEH paired t-test: t = 5.93, df = 5, p = 0.002; ETH vs PSY unpaired t-test: t = 4.00, df = 10, p = 0.003
outcomes.evidence: PSY induced an increase in the acute frequency of HTRs (paired t-test: t = 6.77, df = 5, p = 0.001), as did ETH (paired t-test: t = 5.93, df = 5, p = 0.002). Furthermore, ETH induced a higher HTR frequency than did PSY (unpaired t-test: t = 4.00, df = 10, p = 0.003).

B1_num_measures.evidence: each discrete and brief HTR was given a score of 1

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: For analysis, the 60 min were divided into 4 × 15 min periods... there was a small monotonic decrease across blocks in the case of PSY... and ETH

B4_ethological.evidence: Only head twitch responses scored; HTR is excluded as ethological per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: mice (n = 6 per compound or VEH) were caged singly

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR scoring involves no learning or memory component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: an experimenter blinded to compound/VEH scored head twitch responses (HTRs) continuously

B8_multivariate.evidence: Compound effects on HTRs were analyzed using paired and unpaired t tests

assays.assay_name: Pavlovian Aversion Learning and Memory (tone/context fear conditioning)
assays.assay_description: TSE MultiConditioning System (steel-rod floor, 10 lux). Day 17: 6-min context habituation then PAL (6 tone-footshock pairings, 120 s ITIs); day 18: VEH, PSY or ETH 3 mg/kg p.o.; day 21: PAM expression/extinction test (2-min adjustment, 10 × 30 s tone-CS trials with 90 s ITIs) in same context. % time freezing (IR beam) during CS and ITIs; CON vs chronic social stress (CSS) cohorts.

application_type.evidence: VEH, PSY, ETH per os: oral administration of PSY or ETH at 3 mg/kg in 5 mL/kg VEH

setup_habituation.evidence: On day 17, mice were placed in the context for 6 min habituation without CS or US. Directly thereafter PAL testing was conducted (freezing during this habituation was also reported, Supplementary Figure S1B).

setup_restrain.evidence: a test arena (context) with lid; a floor comprising stainless steel rods... an infra-red beam system for detection of activity or inactivity including... running and jumping

food_restriction.evidence: Conditioning arena (steel-rod floor test arena) contains no food source.

water_restriction.evidence: Conditioning arena (steel-rod floor test arena) contains no water source.

time_to_assay.evidence: On day 21, at 72 h after compound administration, PAM expression testing was conducted.

sample_size.evidence: Mice littermate pairs were assigned randomly and equably to stressor group (CON, CSS) such that n = 40 mice per group... such that n = 12-14 mice per study arm.

outcomes.summary: A single 3 mg/kg oral dose of psilocybin or ethocybin given 24 h after conditioning increased freezing to tone-CS/context at the memory test 72 h later relative to vehicle, in both control and chronically stressed male mice (no Stressor × Compound interaction). Psychedelics had no significant effect on context-only (ITI) freezing; CSS increased freezing in PAL and PAM.
outcomes.statistics: PAM CS/context: Compound main effect F2,74 = 6.13, p = 0.003, η2 = 0.14; Sidak PSY vs VEH p = 0.041, ETH vs VEH p = 0.004; Stressor F1,74 = 7.12, p = 0.009; Stressor × Compound F2,74 = 1.04, p = 0.36. ANCOVA (PAL CS 5-6): F2,73 = 5.61, p = 0.005. ANCOVA (PAL ITI 4-5): F2,73 = 5.47, p = 0.006. Trials 1-4: Compound F2,74 = 7.11, p = 0.002. PAM ITI: Compound F2,74 = 2.17, p = 0.12. Mixed model with litter: Compound F2,34 = 4.06, p = 0.026.
outcomes.evidence: Relative to mice that received VEH, mice that received psychedelic demonstrated increased CS/context PAM expression (Compound main effect: F2, 74 = 6.13, p = 0.003, η2 = 0.14; post hoc Sidak's test: PSY vs. VEH, p = 0.041; ETH vs. VEH, p = 0.004).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Expression of aversive CS/context and context memory were measured, respectively, as percentage of the 30 s CS and 90 s ITI spent in the state of freezing (plus habituation freezing).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: time spent freezing remained stable between trials 1-2 and 7-8 and then decreased at trials 9-10 (Trial main effect: F4, 296 = 13.09, p < 0.001)

B4_ethological.evidence: freezing behavior constitutes the conditioned response — conditioned freezing excluded per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually in the conditioning context; no social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Pavlovian aversion learning-memory (PALM) testing... tone CS paired with foot-shock US

B7_automated_classification.evidence: an infra-red beam system for detection of activity or inactivity

B8_multivariate.evidence: ANOVA/ANCOVA on separate freezing measures; no multivariate analysis.

E2_shelter.evidence: a test arena (context) with lid — no refuge described

E3_bedding.evidence: a floor comprising stainless steel rods for delivery of electrified foot-shocks

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material described in the conditioning arena.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects described in the conditioning arena.

E7_social_context.evidence: mice were placed in the context; no conspecific present during recording

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the conditioning arena.

D1_continuity.evidence: PAL testing on day 17... On day 21, at 72 h after compound administration, PAM expression testing was conducted.

D2_session_duration.evidence: adjustment to the context for 2 min... followed by presentation of ten 30 s CS/context trials interspersed with ITIs of 90 s (~20 min); PAL: 6 min habituation + 6 trials with 120 s ITIs (~18 min)

D3_recording_days.evidence: PAL on day 17 and PAM on day 21

D4_baseline.evidence: On day 17, all mice underwent PAL... On day 18, at 24 h post-PAL testing, compound was administered (PAL freezing reported and used as covariate).

D5_followup.evidence: On day 21, at 72 h after compound administration, PAM expression testing was conducted.

judge_notes: Two behavioural assays retained (HTR, Pavlovian aversion learning-memory); LC-MS/MS pharmacokinetics and vGluT1/Homer1 immunofluorescence excluded as non-behavioural.

Gemma's PAM-only assay merged with PAL+PAM into one fear-conditioning assay per rubric (acquisition + memory phases = 1 assay); D5 set to Yes (PAM 72 h post-dose) and time_to_assay corrected to short_term_1to7d (4320 min).
B1 scores corrected for internal consistency: HTR = 1 measure (score 0); PALM = 2-3 measures (score 1); gemma's scores mismatched its own categories.
HTR D1/D3: crossover design with VEH and drug sessions 3-4 days apart = multiple sessions on 2 days (modal qwen/deepseek).

HTR E8 and food/water restriction: overrode modal 'yes/no restriction' because the cited 'available continuously' statement describes housing, and the test replaced the cage grid/lid (which holds food/water) with a PVC sheet; scored 0 / not_reported with low confidence.

HTR E3/E4 kept as modal Yes (medium confidence) since testing occurred in the cage base of cages described as containing sawdust and tissue bedding; shelter (sleeping house) presence during test not stated, scored 0.
PALM setup_habituation = yes (modal) based on explicit 6-min context habituation before conditioning, though freezing during it was reported; medium confidence.
Vehicle coded 'other' (0.5% hydroxyethyl cellulose in ddH2O); n_male at study level left null as paper does not give a total.
